title: Separation of low-degree coefficients
statement: Let $n$, $\ell$, and $m$ be nonnegative integers, and let $x_1,\dots,x_m$ be points of the Boolean cube $\mathbb F_2^n$. The samples separate the low-degree coefficient arrays if the vector of evaluations at these samples determines the array uniquely: any two arrays indexed by subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$ that agree on all $m$ evaluations are equal.
hypotheses_covered: The sample inputs are $m$ points of $\mathbb F_2^n$
caveat: The definition of the evaluation map and coefficient arrays is not included in the supplied snippet, so their mathematical meaning cannot be fully verified.
